name: app-competitive-analysis-table-and-differentiators-on-black
title: Black 'What exists. What was missing.' slide with a market comparison table and three differentiator cards
whatItIs: A dark slide with outlined pills, large white headings 'What exists. What was missing.' and 'The gap we found: an app that feels as calm and effortless as the ride itself.', a market comparison table of ride apps with check and cross marks where the brand row is highlighted in lime, and three dark cards (Autonomous UX, Voice-first booking, Wrist-native design) with lime dots.
whatItMeans: Clear and persuasive; a table with one lit row proves the gap.
techniques: Highlight your row in the comparison table.
Set giant white statements on dark.
Present differentiators as three dark cards.

vocabulary.definition: A grid comparing products across features.
One row emphasised in a table.
A card stating a unique feature.
